value.rationale: Output-permutation sign is the simplest nontrivial character of the symmetric group and measures a natural departure from uniform parity in the known parking-induced permutation law. A global strict sign bias is not obvious from Pinsky’s factorial-size formula. The quadratic signed recurrence and positive formal differential explanation show nontrivial cancellation and permit systematic exact computation without factorial enumeration. This is a structural and probabilistic refinement, not merely recomputation of point masses.
